We usually require a simple email confirmation of the scope and that the account will transition to a paid plan once the PO clears. If that works, I will: 

1) Provision a temporary 200k token credit to the Olive Analytics sandbox (valid 7 days).
2) Share a one-page confirmation and a DocuSign addendum link for finance.
3) Put a soft hold on the account to avoid accidental auto-suspension.

Marissa — can you prep the addendum template and a quick allocation CSV so we can apply the credit immediately after I sign off? Neha — we may need sales-ops to mark this as an approved make-good for tracking.
